Street sweeping schedule – 2026-27

Piedmont Post · October 7, 2026 · 3 min read

Street sweeping is critical for keeping storm drains clear during leaf drop season. Residents should move cars and any other obstacles blocking access to the curb off the street on street sweeping days.

October 5 - 16

WeekMondayTuesdayWednesdayThursdayFriday
October 5–95 · 1-Odd6 · 2-O7 · 3-O8 · 4-O9 · 5-O
October 12–1612 · 1-Even13 · 2-E14 · 3-E15 · 4-E16 · 5-E
